Senior Backend Engineer - Distributed Systems
Location: Remote (US)
Company: Apex Technologies

About the Role:
We are seeking a Senior Backend Engineer to join our Core Platform team. In this role, you will design, implement, and operate highly scalable microservices that process millions of transactions per day.

Key Responsibilities:
- Design, build, and maintain high-performance, fault-tolerant REST and gRPC microservices.
- Architect real-time event-driven data streaming pipelines using Apache Kafka.
- Optimize database schemas, query performance, and distributed caching in PostgreSQL and Redis.
- Collaborate with infrastructure teams to deploy services on AWS using Docker and Kubernetes.
- Drive engineering excellence through code reviews, automated testing, and observability best practices.

Requirements:
- 4+ years of professional backend software development experience.
- Strong proficiency in Java (Spring Boot) or Go.
- Deep hands-on experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL/MySQL) and caching systems (Redis).
- Proven experience building distributed event-driven systems using Apache Kafka or RabbitMQ.
- Solid experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS) and container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker).
- Strong understanding of RESTful API design, microservice architectures, and observability (Prometheus/Grafana).

Nice to Have:
- Experience with Spring Cloud, gRPC, or GraphQL.
- Familiarity with CI/CD automation using GitHub Actions.
- Prior experience with financial technology or high-throughput payment systems.
